title: Brought Back By Each Other Recovery Shirt | No One Heals Alone Tee
description:
Brought Back By Each Other — a recovery solidarity tee for the people who pull each other through.

Design: clasped hands with snapped chain cuffs and the message "Brought Back / By Each Other / No One Heals Alone." Built for Comfort Colors 1717 garment-dyed heavyweight cotton.

Perfect for: sobriety milestones, sponsorship gifts, recovery community, NA/AA fellowship energy, mental health solidarity.

• Comfort Colors 1717 Unisex Garment-Dyed Heavyweight T-Shirt
• Soft, lived-in feel that gets better with every wash
• Direct-to-garment print — durable and vibrant
• Unisex fit — size up for an oversized look

Care: wash inside out cold, tumble low or hang dry.

This listing is prepared for Printify → Etsy. Review mockups and publish when ready.
